summary: Silicom Ltd., via a Form 6-K filed September 2, 2026, announced a press release detailing a design win with a tier-1 cloud-based cybersecurity customer for a 5G-enabled edge networking device. The customer placed an initial order, with ramp-up expected before year-end 2026 and projected annual revenues exceeding $5 million at full ramp. CEO Liron Eizenman noted this is the eighth design win in 2026, matching full-year 2025 totals, and expects over 50% revenue growth in 2026. This is an ordinary business development announcement, not a special situation.
